punchline: The Dalai Lama says he prefers five decades as a refugee to life in the Potala, which he calls a golden cage.
thirty_sec: Asked about exile, the Dalai Lama cupped his hands into a small circle, then widened them. When he looks only at Tibet's troubles, he worries; when he includes other people's suffering, his own lessens. He called the Potala a golden cage and said he prefers the last five decades of refugee life.
